Adds `owner/repo` to the den extension index.

- [ ] The repository's latest release was made with `release.yml` from den's `examples/hello-extension` (it has `<id>-windows-x86_64.zip` and an `extension.json` with `sha256`).
- [ ] `extension.json` has a description, and the repository a README.md (den shows it before installing).
- [ ] The source is public and builds the released DLL.
